tools.name: cuentica_get_company
tools.description: Get the data of the company this token belongs to. Run this first to confirm the connection. Cuéntica API: GET /company.

tools.name: cuentica_list_series
tools.description: List the invoice series of the company. Use the name in invoice filters. Cuéntica API: GET /company/serie.

tools.name: cuentica_list_tags
tools.description: List the tags of the company. Cuéntica API: GET /tag.

tools.name: cuentica_list_accounts
tools.description: List the company accounts: bank accounts, debit or credit cards and partner accounts. Cuéntica API: GET /account.

tools.name: cuentica_get_account
tools.description: Get one company account by id. Cuéntica API: GET /account/{id}.

tools.name: cuentica_list_customers
tools.description: List customers, paged. Search text matches the business name, address, tax id, phone or email. Cuéntica API: GET /customer.

tools.name: cuentica_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer by id. Cuéntica API: GET /customer/{id}.

tools.name: cuentica_list_providers
tools.description: List providers (suppliers), paged. Search text matches the business name, address, tax id, phone or email. Cuéntica API: GET /provider.

tools.name: cuentica_get_provider
tools.description: Get one provider by id. Cuéntica API: GET /provider/{id}.

tools.name: cuentica_create_customer
tools.description: Create a customer. Required: business_type, address, town, postal_code; business_name for companies; name and surname_1 for individuals. Cuéntica API: POST /customer.

tools.name: cuentica_create_provider
tools.description: Create a provider (supplier). Required: business_type, address, town, postal_code; business_name for companies; name and surname_1 for individuals. Cuéntica API: POST /provider.

tools.name: cuentica_list_invoices
tools.description: List sales invoices, paged. issued=true lists issued invoices; issued=false lists drafts. Cuéntica API: GET /invoice.

tools.name: cuentica_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice by id, with its lines, charges and Verifactu or TicketBAI register info. Cuéntica API: GET /invoice/{id}.

tools.name: cuentica_get_invoice_public_link
tools.description: Get the public preview link of one invoice. The preview has the payment button for the company's Stripe account. Cuéntica API: GET /invoice/{id}/public.

tools.name: cuentica_list_incomes
tools.description: List incomes (money received records), paged. Cuéntica API: GET /income.

tools.name: cuentica_get_income
tools.description: Get one income by id. Cuéntica API: GET /income/{id}.

tools.name: cuentica_list_expenses
tools.description: List expenses (costs), paged. draft=true also shows drafts. Cuéntica API: GET /expense.

tools.name: cuentica_get_expense
tools.description: Get one expense by id. Cuéntica API: GET /expense/{id}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: cuentica_list_customers, cuentica_list_providers · Private data: cuentica_get_company, cuentica_list_incomes · Public sink: cuentica_list_customers, cuentica_list_providers, cuentica_create_customer, cuentica_create_provider · Destructive: cuentica_get_company.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: cuentica_list_customers, cuentica_list_providers · Private data: cuentica_get_company, cuentica_list_incomes · Public sink: cuentica_list_customers, cuentica_list_providers, cuentica_create_customer, cuentica_create_provider · Destructive: cuentica_get_company

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
